name: secret-guard
what: Commands that print credentials and writes that contain a credential are refused, and the refusal never repeats the credential.

faults.fault: The AWS key pattern asks for one character too many, so real keys no longer match.
A bare printenv is no longer treated as a dump of every variable.
The list of template env files forgets .template, so reading one is refused.
The generic sk- key pattern drops its length floor, so short placeholders are refused.
gh auth token is no longer recognised.
